title: Test suite locks in sending promotional email to an opted-out selected user
reasoning: The selected-user test explicitly expects an unsubscribed user to receive a promotional email even when exclude_unsubscribed is enabled. That conflicts with the unsubscribe flow and the filtered-send test, both of which treat receive_promotional_emails=False as the mechanism for opting out of promotional email. Keeping this expectation in the suite can preserve a privacy/compliance-sensitive behavior instead of catching it.
recommendation: Clarify the product rule. If opt-out should always apply, change the test to expect only subscribed selected users to receive the email and update the task logic accordingly. If manual selection is intentionally allowed to override opt-out, add an explicit authorization/audit test and document that exception.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing test covers the opposite behavior and labels it as current task logic, so it would fail a fix that respects opt-out for selected users.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a selected_users case with exclude_unsubscribed=True where one selected profile has receive_promotional_emails=False and assert that only subscribed selected users are emailed.
minimumFixScope: Update the selected-user unsubscribe test expectation and, if needed, the promo email recipient filtering logic it describes.
